## Coordinated finish - draft PR (Option 2), three members

**Activation.** The home spec `doc/specs/shared.md` has a `## Legs` section with three members: repo-a (home), repo-b, and repo-c. The coordinated mechanics therefore replace the home-only delivery and cleanup steps. The recorded `contract:` lines are authoritative, and overrides are not reread.

**Choice.** The human chose row 2, draft PR. I apply it to the companions in declared order (repo-b, then repo-c), then to home. Draft PR has no cleanup step, so every worktree and branch is kept.

### 1. Receipt validation and freshness

- **Receipts.** I check `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/` and find no receipts. No leg can be skipped as receipt-proven, so all three legs are unlanded.
- **Freshness check.** For each leg, I compare its retained audited head and tree with the current checkout, covering staged, unstaged and untracked state. All three legs are still at their audited clean heads, so no re-verification or re-review is needed.
- **Prior gates.** The following passed with these audited heads and still hold:
  - `node --test test/parser.test.mjs` in each leg's worktree.
  - Conformance per leg:
    - AC1 is owned by repo-a and repo-b.
    - AC2 is owned by repo-c.
    - Each leg was checked against its own `Rules: AGENTS.md`.
  - Disposition closure.

### 2. Companion delivery (declared order)

**repo-b**, in its worktree (per the brief / recorded `home:` pattern):

```bash
git -C <repo-b worktree> push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd <repo-b worktree> && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "<repo-b body style; includes:>
Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md")
```

- The push succeeds and the PR is created at https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2.
- No plan strip or telemetry seal runs in repo-b.
- I write the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-b`:

```text
attempted-head: <full repo-b feature SHA>
delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2 <full repo-b feature SHA>
verification: passed
```

**repo-c**, in `/work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`:

```bash
git -C /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "<repo-c body style; includes:>
Home: repo-a feature/shared-change doc/specs/shared.md")
```

- The push succeeds and the PR is created at https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3.
- No plan strip or telemetry seal runs in repo-c.
- I write the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-c`:

```text
attempted-head: <full repo-c feature SHA>
delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3 <full repo-c feature SHA>
verification: passed
```

### 3. Home strip-and-seal (complete companion results only)

- Both companion results are collected. Before the strip, I capture the spec path, the recorded verification command and the accepted task evidence.
- I strip the plan only from the home branch. This applies to `doc/plans/shared.md` and `doc/plans/shared-ledger.md` if they are tracked; the spec and telemetry are preserved.
- Then I seal once:

```bash
node <bin>/gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs --worktree /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change \
  --option pr --base <base-branch> --spec doc/specs/shared.md \
  --leg repo-b=https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2 \
  --leg repo-c=https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
```

- There is no existing seal whose `legs:` set needs comparing.
- The seal's stdout is printed verbatim in the completion message below.
- No companion `.pi/gauntlet/telemetry/` is written.

### 4. Home delivery

```bash
git -C /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change push -u origin feature/shared-change
(cd /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change && gh pr create --draft --title "<title>" --body "...")
```

- The home body contains `## Summary` and `## Test Plan`. It also lists the companion PRs:
  - https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
  - https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
- The push succeeds and the PR is created at https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1.
- I write the receipt `/work/repo-a/.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/repo-a`:

```text
attempted-head: <full repo-a feature SHA>
delivered: pr https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1 <full repo-a feature SHA>
verification: passed
```

### 5. Cleanup and receipts

- Draft PR has no cleanup requirement, so I run no recorded contract:
  - not repo-a's `script/tree destroy <name>`
  - not repo-b's `script/wrapper remove <name>` or its teardown hook
  - not repo-c's built-in removal
- All worktrees and branches are kept.
- Home delivery landed, so I remove the receipts now.
- I call `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "ship" })`.

---

```
gauntlet: done pr-created
Shipped: repo-b https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2 (draft)
Shipped: repo-c https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3 (draft)
Shipped: repo-a https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1 (draft)
Not shipped: none

Telemetry seal: <gauntlet-telemetry-seal.mjs stdout, verbatim>

Home delivery and required cleanup succeeded; receipts removed

Worktrees preserved (branch feature/shared-change in each):
- repo-a: /work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change
- repo-b: <repo-b worktree, from brief / recorded home: pattern>
- repo-c: /work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change
```

Once the merge and deploy land, run `/skill:check-delivery <ticket-ref>` to prove delivery before advancing the ticket.
